positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Enhanced System Scalability: Optimized UI and table performance, increasing rendering capacity from thousands to over 1 million items, significantly improving user experience for large-scale data interactions.  
- Pioneered AI Integration: Researched and implemented advanced AI agents using LlamaIndex, LangChain, and LangGraph, developing a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) agent with ChromaDB and custom tools to enhance automation and decision-making capabilities.  
- Improved Data Recovery: Designed and implemented document recovery features, including a Document Change Log and Recycle Bin, streamlining user access to critical files and reducing data loss incidents.
- Strengthened Security Posture: Identified and resolved security vulnerabilities using Snyk, ensuring robust protection for sensitive data and compliance with industry standards.  
- Advanced Accessibility Standards: Integrated narrator support, hotkeys, shortcuts, and keyboard navigation, keeping us AA compliant.
- Optimized Syncing and User Experience: Routinely enhanced file syncing algorithms to improve reliability and performance, reducing sync errors. Proactively investigated and resolved user-reported bugs related to synchronization and file/folder issues, achieving a 100% resolution rate for user tickets and improving overall system usability.
positions.insights: Large Language Models (LLM), LangChain and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhanced Testing Frameworks: Authored comprehensive unit and integration tests, achieving 80% code coverage and reducing post-release defects by 20%.  
Developed File Backup Solution: Engineered a file backup utility that restored missing files and versions on demand, improving data reliability for enterprise users.  
Integrated Cross-Platform Functionality: Seamlessly connected JavaScript web extension context menus with desktop application APIs, enhancing user interaction across platforms.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Create an in-house spring-boot application utilizing Amazon's AWS, APIs, python scripts, and databases to generate 100% of the paper reports printing to students and schools. Millions of students and thousands of schools receive customized reports that are generated through this new cost saving application.
•	Create on-demand data files using AWS Lambda functions and develop the front-end using React, automating 100% of the work needed to create these files.
•	Create and maintain Apache Kafka spring-boot application to transform large amounts of data quickly and efficiently.
•       Monitor and support applications deployed through Kubernetes.
•       Design and architect applications to provide business value to the company and to further automate existing processes.

projects.title: Discord AI Chatbot
projects.description:
- Developed Intelligent Chatbot: Engineered an advanced AI chatbot using the Eliza OS framework, integrating dynamic memory retrieval with SQLite embeddings for context-aware interactions.  
- Implemented Adaptive Learning: Enabled the agent to learn over time, categorizing memories and ranking their importance, resulting in a 60% improvement in response relevance.  
- Built Comprehensive Economy System: Designed a robust reputation, inventory, crafting, and economy system, allowing users to engage in jobs, earn currency, and exchange items, enhancing user engagement by 40%.  
- Created Versatile Tools: Developed custom tools for the agent, including real-time data retrieval from online articles, wikis, and APIs, enabling dynamic and informed responses.
